```{r}
library(stringr)
getwd()
MG1655_gff <-  read.csv("./data/input/Annotations.csv", header = F)

MG1655_gff <- subset(MG1655_gff, MG1655_gff$V3 != "gene")

MG1655_gff$locus_tag <- str_extract(MG1655_gff$V9, pattern = "(?<=locus_tag=)[^;]*")
MG1655_gff$gene <- str_extract(MG1655_gff$V9, pattern = "(?<=gene=)[^;]*")
MG1655_gff$product <- str_extract(MG1655_gff$V9, pattern = "(?<=product=)[^;]*")
MG1655_gff <- MG1655_gff[!duplicated(MG1655_gff$locus_tag),]
MG1655_gff$chr <- "NC_000913.3 Escherichia coli str. K-12 substr. MG1655, complete genome"

MG1655_official_reference <- MG1655_gff[ , c(10, 1, 4:5, 7, 11:12)]
colnames(MG1655_official_reference) <- c("GeneID", "chr", "start", "end", "strand", "gene", "product")

MG1655_annotations <- MG1655_official_reference[ , c(1:5)]

write.csv(MG1655_official_reference, "./data/output/MG1655_official_reference_annotations.csv", quote = F, row.names = F)
```

```{r}
library(Rsubread)
```

```{r}
bams <- dir(path = "./data/input/reads/bams", pattern = "*.BAM$", full.names = T, recursive = F)
ann <- MG1655_annotations
fc_SE <- featureCounts(files = bams, annot.ext = ann, isPairedEnd = T, nthreads = 20)
write.csv(fc_SE$counts, "./data/output/counts.csv", quote = F, row.names = T)
write.csv(fc_SE$stat, "./data/output/stats.csv", quote = F, row.names = T)
```

```{r}
library(edgeR)

counts <- read.csv("./data/output/counts.csv", header = T)
colnames(counts) <- c("X","EGFP_1077_01", "EGFP_1077_02", "EGFP_1077_03", "Kpn_518_01", "Kpn_518_02", "Kpn_518_03","NEOC3_1802_01", "NEOC4_1803_01", "NEOC7_1829_01")

x <- counts[ , 2:10]
counts[is.na(counts)] <- "Misc"
rownames(x) <- counts[ , 1]

group <- factor(c("1", "1", "1", "2", "2", "2", "3", "4", "5"))

y <- DGEList(counts = x, group = group)
design <- model.matrix(~0 + group, data = y$samples)
keep <- filterByExpr(y, design, min.count = 0)
keep_df <- data.frame(keep)
y <- y[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = F]
#y <- calcNormFactors(y)
y <- normLibSizes(y)
y <- estimateCommonDisp(y, design = group)
y$genes <- data.frame(fc_SE$annotation$Length[keep_df$keep])

write.csv(cpm(y, log = T), "./data/output/log_cpm_counts.csv", quote = F, row.names = T)

log_cpm_data <- cpm(y, log = T)

rpkm <- rpkm(y)
write.csv(rpkm, "./data/output/RPKM.csv", quote = F, row.names = T)
log_rpkm <- rpkm(y, log = T)
write.csv(log_rpkm, "./data/output/log_RPKM.csv", quote = F, row.names = T)
group_rpkm <- rpkmByGroup(y, group = group)
write.csv(group_rpkm, "./data/output/grouped_RPKM.csv", quote = F, row.names = T)
log_group_rpkm <- rpkmByGroup(y, group = group , log = T)
write.csv(log_group_rpkm, "./data/output/log_grouped_RPKM.csv", quote = F, row.names = T)

cpm <- cpm(y)
write.csv(cpm, "./data/output/CPM.csv", quote = F, row.names = T)
log_cpm <- cpm(y, log = T)
write.csv(log_cpm, "./data/output/log_CPM.csv", quote = F, row.names = T)
group_cpm <- cpmByGroup(y, group = group)
write.csv(group_cpm, "./data/output/grouped_CPM.csv", quote = F, row.names = T)
log_group_cpm <- cpmByGroup(y, group = group , log =T)
write.csv(log_group_cpm, "./data/output/log_grouped_CPM.csv", quote = F, row.names = T)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggthemes)

mds <- plotMDS(log_cpm_data, gene.selection = "common")

mds_plot_data <- data.frame(x = mds$x, y = mds$y, Group = factor(c("EGFP_1077_01", "EGFP_1077_02", "EGFP_1077_03", "Kpn_518_01", "Kpn_518_02", "Kpn_518_03","NEOC3_1802_01", "NEOC4_1803_01", "NEOC7_1829_01")))

row.names(mds_plot_data) <- c("EGFP_1077_01", "EGFP_1077_02", "EGFP_1077_03", "Kpn_518_01", "Kpn_518_02", "Kpn_518_03","NEOC3_1802_01", "NEOC4_1803_01", "NEOC7_1829_01")

mds_plot_data_colors <- c("1" = "red", "2" = "blue", "3" = "darkgreen", "4" = "orange", "5" = "maroon")

tiff("./data/output/pca_plot.tif", res = 300, width = 10, height = 5, units = "in")
ggplot(data = mds_plot_data, aes(x = x, y = y))+
  xlab("Principal Component 1 (33%)")+
  ylab("Principal Component 2 (26%)")+
  #xlim(-0.8,0.8)+
  #ylim(-0.6,0.6)+
  ggtitle("PCA plot of distances between gene expression profiles")+
  geom_point(shape = 21, color = "black", size = 4, stroke = 1, aes(fill = group))+
  scale_fill_manual(values = mds_plot_data_colors)+
  geom_text_repel(data = mds_plot_data, aes(x = x, y = y), label = rownames(mds_plot_data), min.segment.length = 0, max.overlaps = 20, box.padding = 0.7, direction = "both", point.padding = 0)+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1/2, plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 18), panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.background = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_text(color="black", size = 11), axis.text.y = element_text(color="black", size = 11), axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15), axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15), axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), legend.position = "none")
dev.off()
```

```{r}
library(pheatmap)

library(viridisLite)
library(viridis)

cor.matrix <- cor(log_cpm_data, method = "pearson")

tiff("./data/output/correlation_heatmap.tif", res = 300, width = 14, height = 25, units = "in")
pheatmap(cor.matrix, color = viridis(10), cluster_rows = F, cluster_cols = F, cellwidth = 50, cellheight = 50, main = "Pearson Correlation", legend = F, border_color = "black", display_numbers = T, number_color = "red", fontsize = 15, angle_col = 315)
dev.off()
```

```{r}
library(edgeR)
library(dplyr)

fit <- glmQLFit(y, design)

EGFP_v_KpnNEO <- glmQLFTest(fit, contrast = c(-1, 1, 0, 0, 0))

dge_EGFP_v_KpnNEO <- topTags(EGFP_v_KpnNEO, n = 10000, adjust.method = "BH", sort.by = "PValue", p.value = 1)$table

dge_EGFP_v_KpnNEO$GeneID <-  rownames(dge_EGFP_v_KpnNEO)

dge_EGFP_v_KpnNEO <- dge_EGFP_v_KpnNEO %>% left_join(MG1655_official_reference,by="GeneID")

dge_EGFP_v_KpnNEO[is.na(dge_EGFP_v_KpnNEO$gene),]$gene <- "N/A"

dge_EGFP_v_KpnNEO$gene <- gsub("'", '', dge_EGFP_v_KpnNEO$gene)
dge_EGFP_v_KpnNEO$product <- gsub("'", '', dge_EGFP_v_KpnNEO$product)

dge_EGFP_v_KpnNEO$info <- paste0("Accession: ", dge_EGFP_v_KpnNEO$chr, " | gene: ", dge_EGFP_v_KpnNEO$gene, " | product: ", dge_EGFP_v_KpnNEO$product, " | locus_tag: ", dge_EGFP_v_KpnNEO$GeneID, " | logFC: ", dge_EGFP_v_KpnNEO$logFC, " | FDR: ", dge_EGFP_v_KpnNEO$FDR)

write.csv(dge_EGFP_v_KpnNEO, "./data/output/dge_EGFP_v_KpnNEO.csv", quote = F, row.names = T)
write.csv(dge_EGFP_v_KpnNEO[abs(dge_EGFP_v_KpnNEO$logFC) >= 1 & dge_EGFP_v_KpnNEO$FDR < 0.05, ], "./data/output/dge_EGFP_v_KpnNEO_hits.csv" , quote = F, row.names = T)
write.csv(dge_EGFP_v_KpnNEO[dge_EGFP_v_KpnNEO$logFC >=1 & dge_EGFP_v_KpnNEO$FDR < 0.05, ], "./data/output/dge_EGFP_v_KpnNEO_hits_up.csv" , quote = F, row.names = T)
write.csv(dge_EGFP_v_KpnNEO[dge_EGFP_v_KpnNEO$logFC <=-1 & dge_EGFP_v_KpnNEO$FDR < 0.05, ], "./data/output/dge_EGFP_v_KpnNEO_hits_down.csv" , quote = F, row.names = T)

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggthemes)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggiraph)
library(htmltools)
library(htmlwidgets)

EGFP_v_KpnNEO <- ggplot(subset(dge_EGFP_v_KpnNEO), aes(logFC, -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_point_interactive(shape = 19, size = 1, color = "gray70", aes(tooltip = info, data_id = info))+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40")+
  geom_vline(xintercept = -2, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40")+
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40")+
  geom_point_interactive(data = subset(dge_EGFP_v_KpnNEO)[subset(dge_EGFP_v_KpnNEO)$logFC >=2 & subset(dge_EGFP_v_KpnNEO)$FDR < 0.05, ], shape = 21, size = 1, aes(fill = chr))+
  geom_point_interactive(data = subset(dge_EGFP_v_KpnNEO)[subset(dge_EGFP_v_KpnNEO)$logFC <=-2 & subset(dge_EGFP_v_KpnNEO)$FDR < 0.05, ], shape = 21, size = 1, aes(fill = chr))+
  scale_fill_manual(guide = "legend", name = "", values = c("lightblue", "darkgreen", "maroon","orange")) +
  ggtitle("EGFP vs. KpnNEO")+
  ylab(bquote(-log[10](FDR)))+
  xlab(bquote(log[2]("expression fold change")))+
  theme(aspect.ratio =  1/2, legend.position = "right", plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 12), panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black"), text = element_text(size = 12), axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12), axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12)) 

EGFP_v_KpnNEO_interactive <- girafe(ggobj = EGFP_v_KpnNEO)
saveWidget(EGFP_v_KpnNEO_interactive, "./data/output/EGFP_v_KpnNEO_interactive.html")

```

```{r}
library(edgeR)
library(dplyr)
```
```{r}
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)
library(htmlwidgets)

# ============================================================
# Output directory and thresholds
# ============================================================

output_dir <- "./data/output"

dir.create(
  output_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

hit_logFC_threshold <- 1
plot_logFC_threshold <- 4
FDR_threshold <- 0.05

# ============================================================
# Fit the edgeR model once
# ============================================================

fit <- glmQLFit(y, design)

# Positive logFC means higher expression in the NEO condition
# relative to EGFP because each contrast is NEO - EGFP.

contrast_list <- list(
  KpnNEO = c(-1, 1, 0, 0, 0),
  C3.1bNEO = c(-1, 0, 1, 0, 0),
  C4.1bNEO = c(-1, 0, 0, 1, 0),
  C7.6bNEO = c(-1, 0, 0, 0, 1)
)

file_name_list <- c(
  KpnNEO = "KpnNEO",
  C3.1bNEO = "c3_1NEO",
  C4.1bNEO = "c4_1NEO",
  C7.6bNEO = "c7_6NEO"
)

# ============================================================
# Function to run one contrast, annotate results, and save CSVs
# ============================================================

run_dge_contrast <- function(
    fit,
    contrast_vector,
    comparison_name,
    file_name,
    reference_table,
    output_dir,
    hit_logFC_threshold = 1,
    FDR_threshold = 0.05
) {

  qlf_test <- glmQLFTest(
    fit,
    contrast = contrast_vector
  )

  dge_table <- topTags(
    qlf_test,
    n = Inf,
    adjust.method = "BH",
    sort.by = "PValue",
    p.value = 1
  )$table

  dge_table <- dge_table %>%
    rownames_to_column("GeneID") %>%
    left_join(
      reference_table,
      by = "GeneID"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      NEO = comparison_name,

      gene = if_else(
        is.na(gene) | gene == "",
        "N/A",
        as.character(gene)
      ),

      product = if_else(
        is.na(product) | product == "",
        "N/A",
        as.character(product)
      ),

      chr = if_else(
        is.na(chr) | chr == "",
        "N/A",
        as.character(chr)
      ),

      gene = gsub(
        "'",
        "",
        gene
      ),

      product = gsub(
        "'",
        "",
        product
      ),

      # Avoid Inf when FDR is exactly zero
      FDR_plot = pmax(
        FDR,
        .Machine$double.xmin
      ),

      info = paste0(
        "NEO: ", NEO,
        " | Accession: ", chr,
        " | gene: ", gene,
        " | product: ", product,
        " | locus_tag: ", GeneID,
        " | logFC: ", round(logFC, 4),
        " | FDR: ", signif(FDR, 4)
      ),

      # The same GeneID occurs in all four comparisons,
      # so data_id must include the comparison name.
      point_id = paste(
        NEO,
        GeneID,
        sep = "_"
      )
    )

  # Complete result table
  write.csv(
    dge_table,
    file.path(
      output_dir,
      paste0(
        "dge_EGFP_v_",
        file_name,
        ".csv"
      )
    ),
    quote = FALSE,
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  # All differentially expressed hits
  write.csv(
    dge_table %>%
      filter(
        abs(logFC) >= hit_logFC_threshold,
        FDR < FDR_threshold
      ),
    file.path(
      output_dir,
      paste0(
        "dge_EGFP_v_",
        file_name,
        "_hits.csv"
      )
    ),
    quote = FALSE,
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  # Upregulated hits
  write.csv(
    dge_table %>%
      filter(
        logFC >= hit_logFC_threshold,
        FDR < FDR_threshold
      ),
    file.path(
      output_dir,
      paste0(
        "dge_EGFP_v_",
        file_name,
        "_hits_up.csv"
      )
    ),
    quote = FALSE,
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  # Downregulated hits
  write.csv(
    dge_table %>%
      filter(
        logFC <= -hit_logFC_threshold,
        FDR < FDR_threshold
      ),
    file.path(
      output_dir,
      paste0(
        "dge_EGFP_v_",
        file_name,
        "_hits_down.csv"
      )
    ),
    quote = FALSE,
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  return(dge_table)
}

# ============================================================
# Run all four differential-expression comparisons
# ============================================================

dge_results <- lapply(
  names(contrast_list),
  function(comparison_name) {

    run_dge_contrast(
      fit = fit,
      contrast_vector = contrast_list[[comparison_name]],
      comparison_name = comparison_name,
      file_name = file_name_list[[comparison_name]],
      reference_table = MG1655_official_reference,
      output_dir = output_dir,
      hit_logFC_threshold = hit_logFC_threshold,
      FDR_threshold = FDR_threshold
    )
  }
)

names(dge_results) <- names(contrast_list)

# Preserve the four individual dataframe names used previously
dge_EGFP_v_KpnNEO <- dge_results[["KpnNEO"]]
dge_EGFP_v_c3_1NEO <- dge_results[["C3.1bNEO"]]
dge_EGFP_v_c4_1NEO <- dge_results[["C4.1bNEO"]]
dge_EGFP_v_c7_6NEO <- dge_results[["C7.6bNEO"]]

# ============================================================
# Combine all four datasets
# ============================================================

dge_all_NEOs <- bind_rows(
  dge_results
) %>%
  mutate(
    NEO = factor(
      NEO,
      levels = c(
        "KpnNEO",
        "C3.1bNEO",
        "C4.1bNEO",
        "C7.6bNEO"
      )
    ),

    Significant = (
      abs(logFC) >= plot_logFC_threshold &
        FDR < FDR_threshold
    ),

    Direction = case_when(
      Significant & logFC >= plot_logFC_threshold ~
        "Upregulated",

      Significant & logFC <= -plot_logFC_threshold ~
        "Downregulated",

      TRUE ~
        "Not significant"
    )
  )

write.csv(
  dge_all_NEOs,
  file.path(
    output_dir,
    "dge_all_NEOs_vs_EGFP.csv"
  ),
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Separate background and significant points
dge_all_NEOs_background <- dge_all_NEOs %>%
  filter(!Significant)

dge_all_NEOs_significant <- dge_all_NEOs %>%
  filter(Significant)

# ============================================================
# Single interactive volcano plot containing all four datasets
# ============================================================

all_NEOs_volcano <- ggplot(
  dge_all_NEOs,
  aes(
    x = logFC,
    y = -log10(FDR_plot)
  )
) +

  # All nonsignificant points
  geom_point_interactive(
    data = dge_all_NEOs_background,
    aes(
      tooltip = info,
      data_id = point_id
    ),
    shape = 19,
    size = 1,
    color = "gray70",
    alpha = 0.35
  ) +

  # Fold-change thresholds
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = plot_logFC_threshold,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "gray40"
  ) +

  geom_vline(
    xintercept = -plot_logFC_threshold,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "gray40"
  ) +

  # FDR threshold
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = -log10(FDR_threshold),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "gray40"
  ) +

  # Significant points colored by NEO comparison
  geom_point_interactive(
    data = dge_all_NEOs_significant,
    aes(
      fill = NEO,
      tooltip = info,
      data_id = point_id
    ),
    shape = 21,
    size = 1.7,
    color = "black",
    stroke = 0.25,
    alpha = 0.85
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    guide = "legend",
    name = "",
    values = c(
      "KpnNEO" = "lightblue",
      "C3.1bNEO" = "darkgreen",
      "C4.1bNEO" = "maroon",
      "C7.6bNEO" = "orange"
    )
  ) +

  ggtitle(
    "All NEOs vs. EGFP"
  ) +

  ylab(
    bquote(-log[10](FDR))
  ) +

  xlab(
    bquote(log[2]("expression fold change"))
  ) +

  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1 / 2,

    legend.position = "right",

    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold",
      size = 12
    ),

    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

    panel.background = element_rect(
      fill = "white",
      colour = "black"
    ),

    text = element_text(
      size = 12
    ),

    axis.title.y = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 12
    ),

    axis.title.x = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 12
    )
  )

print(all_NEOs_volcano)

# ============================================================
# Save static PDF and PNG versions
# ============================================================

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    output_dir,
    "all_NEOs_vs_EGFP_volcano.pdf"
  ),
  plot = all_NEOs_volcano,
  width = 9,
  height = 5.5,
  units = "in"
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    output_dir,
    "all_NEOs_vs_EGFP_volcano.png"
  ),
  plot = all_NEOs_volcano,
  width = 9,
  height = 5.5,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 600
)

# ============================================================
# Create and save the interactive HTML plot
# ============================================================

all_NEOs_volcano_interactive <- girafe(
  ggobj = all_NEOs_volcano,
  width_svg = 9,
  height_svg = 5.5
)

saveWidget(
  all_NEOs_volcano_interactive,
  file.path(
    output_dir,
    "all_NEOs_vs_EGFP_volcano_interactive.html"
  ),
  selfcontained = TRUE
)
```
```{r}
library(edgeR)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)
library(stringr)

# ============================================================
# Settings
# ============================================================

annotation_file <- "./data/input/Annotations.csv"

plot_logFC_threshold <- 2
FDR_threshold <- 0.05

NEO_levels <- c(
  "KpnNEO",
  "C3.1bNEO",
  "C4.1bNEO",
  "C7.6bNEO"
)

# ============================================================
# Check required objects
# ============================================================

required_objects <- c(
  "y",
  "design"
)

missing_objects <- required_objects[
  !vapply(
    required_objects,
    exists,
    logical(1),
    inherits = TRUE
  )
]

if (length(missing_objects) > 0) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "Missing required object(s): ",
      paste(
        missing_objects,
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  )
}

if (!file.exists(annotation_file)) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "Annotation file was not found: ",
      annotation_file
    )
  )
}

# ============================================================
# Read the annotation file
#
# This is a headerless nine-column GFF-style CSV file.
# ============================================================

annotation_raw <- read.csv(
  annotation_file,
  header = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE,
  quote = "\"",
  comment.char = ""
)

if (ncol(annotation_raw) != 9) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "The annotation file should contain 9 columns, but ",
      ncol(annotation_raw),
      " columns were detected."
    )
  )
}

colnames(annotation_raw) <- c(
  "seqid",
  "description",
  "feature_type",
  "start",
  "end",
  "score",
  "strand",
  "phase",
  "attributes"
)

# ============================================================
# Extract a named attribute from the GFF attributes column
# ============================================================

extract_attribute <- function(attributes, key) {

  attributes <- as.character(
    attributes
  )

  pattern <- paste0(
    "(?:^|;)",
    key,
    "=([^;]+)"
  )

  value <- str_match(
    attributes,
    pattern
  )[, 2]

  value <- str_replace_all(
    value,
    regex(
      "%2C",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    ","
  )

  value <- str_replace_all(
    value,
    regex(
      "%3B",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    ";"
  )

  value <- str_replace_all(
    value,
    regex(
      "%28",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    "("
  )

  value <- str_replace_all(
    value,
    regex(
      "%29",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    ")"
  )

  value <- str_replace_all(
    value,
    regex(
      "%2B",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    "+"
  )

  value <- str_replace_all(
    value,
    "\u00A0",
    " "
  )

  str_squish(
    value
  )
}

# ============================================================
# Parse structured annotation fields
#
# No gene name is inferred from the final word of a product.
# The actual gene and product attributes are retained.
# ============================================================

annotation_parsed <- annotation_raw %>%
  mutate(
    gene = extract_attribute(
      attributes,
      "gene"
    ),

    locus_tag = extract_attribute(
      attributes,
      "locus_tag"
    ),

    product = extract_attribute(
      attributes,
      "product"
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# Return the first nonmissing annotation within each locus
# ============================================================

first_nonmissing <- function(x) {

  x <- as.character(
    x
  )

  x <- x[
    !is.na(x) &
      x != ""
  ]

  if (length(x) == 0) {
    return("N/A")
  }

  x[1]
}

# ============================================================
# Collapse gene and CDS rows into one annotation per locus tag
# ============================================================

MG1655_annotation <- annotation_parsed %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(locus_tag),
    locus_tag != ""
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    locus_tag
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    chr = first_nonmissing(
      seqid
    ),

    gene = first_nonmissing(
      gene
    ),

    product = first_nonmissing(
      product
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rename(
    GeneID = locus_tag
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    GeneID = as.character(
      GeneID
    ),

    gene_lower = tolower(
      str_squish(
        gene
      )
    ),

    product_lower = tolower(
      str_squish(
        product
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    GeneID,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )

# ============================================================
# Functional classification
#
# Classification uses:
#   1. Exact gene-name matches.
#   2. Specific functional descriptions in the product field.
#
# Example:
#   gene    = yjfJ
#   product = PspA family protein YjfJ
#
# This matches "PspA family protein" and is classified as
# Envelope and membrane stress.
# ============================================================

classify_function <- function(
    gene_lower,
    product_lower
) {

  gene_lower <- ifelse(
    is.na(gene_lower),
    "",
    tolower(
      gene_lower
    )
  )

  product_lower <- ifelse(
    is.na(product_lower),
    "",
    tolower(
      product_lower
    )
  )

  case_when(

    # ========================================================
    # Envelope and membrane stress
    # ========================================================

    gene_lower %in% c(
      "pspa",
      "pspb",
      "pspc",
      "pspd",
      "pspe",
      "pspg",
      "cpxp",
      "yagu",
      "yjfj",
      "osmb",
      "bsma",
      "yiad",
      "alx",
      "asr",
      "lpxc",
      "yqae",
      "bord",
      "atpi"
    ) ~

      "Envelope and membrane stress",

    str_detect(
      product_lower,
      paste0(
        "\\bpspa family protein\\b|",
        "\\bphage shock protein a\\b|",
        "\\bphage shock protein b\\b|",
        "\\bphage shock protein c\\b|",
        "\\bphage shock protein d\\b|",
        "\\bphage shock protein e\\b|",
        "\\bphage shock protein g\\b|",
        "\\bperiplasmic protein cpxp\\b|",
        "\\bosmotically[- ]inducible lipoprotein\\b|",
        "\\bmembrane[- ]bound redox modulator\\b|",
        "\\bperiplasmic chaperone asr\\b|",
        "\\bduf1471 domain[- ]containing putative lipoprotein\\b|",
        "\\bpf13488 family lipoprotein\\b|",
        "\\budp-3-o-acyl-n-acetylglucosamine deacetylase\\b|",
        "\\batp synthase accessory factor atpi\\b"
      )
    ) ~

      "Envelope and membrane stress",

    # ========================================================
    # Stress response and global regulation
    # ========================================================

    gene_lower %in% c(
      "soxs",
      "ibpa",
      "ibpb",
      "ytfk",
      "dusb",
      "fis",
      "mara",
      "marr",
      "marb",
      "rpoh",
      "iscr",
      "nahr",
      "soda",
      "trxc",
      "nrdh",
      "nrdi",
      "cyar",
      "glmz",
      "rbsz",
      "rttr",
      "dksa",
      "grea",
      "dead",
      "obge",
      "yjfn",
      "yjhq",
      "chps",
      "slyx",

# ============================================================
# Fit the edgeR model once
# ============================================================

fit <- glmQLFit(
  y,
  design
)

# Positive logFC means higher expression in the NEO condition
# relative to EGFP.
# ============================================================

contrast_list <- list(
  KpnNEO = c(-1, 1, 0, 0, 0),
  C3.1bNEO = c(-1, 0, 1, 0, 0),
  C4.1bNEO = c(-1, 0, 0, 1, 0),
  C7.6bNEO = c(-1, 0, 0, 0, 1)
)

# ============================================================
# Run all four differential-expression comparisons
# ============================================================

dge_results <- lapply(
  names(contrast_list),
  function(comparison_name) {

    qlf_test <- glmQLFTest(
      fit,
      contrast = contrast_list[[comparison_name]]
    )

    topTags(
      qlf_test,
      n = Inf,
      adjust.method = "BH",
      sort.by = "PValue",
      p.value = 1
    )$table %>%
      rownames_to_column(
        "GeneID"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        GeneID = as.character(
          GeneID
        )
      ) %>%
      left_join(
        MG1655_annotation,
        by = "GeneID"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        NEO = comparison_name,

        gene = if_else(
          is.na(gene) |
            gene == "",
          "N/A",
          gene
        ),

        product = if_else(
          is.na(product) |
            product == "",
          "N/A",
          product
        ),

        chr = if_else(
          is.na(chr) |
            chr == "",
          "N/A",
          chr
        ),

        gene_lower = tolower(
          str_squish(
            gene
          )
        ),

        product_lower = tolower(
          str_squish(
            product
          )
        ),

        FDR_plot = pmax(
          FDR,
          .Machine$double.xmin
        ),

        point_id = paste(
          NEO,
          GeneID,
          sep = "_"
        )
      )
  }
)

names(dge_results) <- names(
  contrast_list
)

# Preserve the individual dataframes
dge_EGFP_v_KpnNEO <- dge_results[["KpnNEO"]]
dge_EGFP_v_c3_1NEO <- dge_results[["C3.1bNEO"]]
dge_EGFP_v_c4_1NEO <- dge_results[["C4.1bNEO"]]
dge_EGFP_v_c7_6NEO <- dge_results[["C7.6bNEO"]]

# ============================================================
# Combine, determine significance, and classify functions
#
# Significant:
#   logFC >= 2 or logFC <= -2
#   FDR < 0.05
# ============================================================

dge_all_NEOs <- bind_rows(
  dge_results
) %>%
  mutate(
    NEO = factor(
      NEO,
      levels = NEO_levels
    ),

    Significant = (
      abs(logFC) >= plot_logFC_threshold &
        FDR < FDR_threshold
    ),

    Direction = case_when(
      Significant &
        logFC >= plot_logFC_threshold ~
        "Upregulated",

      Significant &
        logFC <= -plot_logFC_threshold ~
        "Downregulated",

      TRUE ~
        "Not significant"
    ),

    Function_category = classify_function(
      gene_lower = gene_lower,
      product_lower = product_lower
    ),

    Highlight_function = (
      Significant &
        !is.na(Function_category)
    ),

    Function_category = factor(
      Function_category,
      levels = c(
        "Envelope and membrane stress",
        "Stress response and global regulation",
        "Membrane and periplasmic transport",
        "Carbon, amino-acid and nucleotide metabolism"
      )
    ),

    info = paste0(
      "NEO: ", NEO,
      " | gene: ", gene,
      " | product: ", product,
      " | locus_tag: ", GeneID,
      " | logFC: ", round(logFC, 4),
      " | FDR: ", signif(FDR, 4),
      " | direction: ", Direction,
      " | category: ",
      if_else(
        is.na(Function_category),
        "Other",
        as.character(Function_category)
      )
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# Separate plotting layers
# ============================================================

# Genes below the logFC/FDR thresholds
dge_nonsignificant <- dge_all_NEOs %>%
  filter(
    !Significant
  )

# Significant genes that do not match a defined category
dge_other_significant <- dge_all_NEOs %>%
  filter(
    Significant,
    is.na(Function_category)
  )

# Significant genes matching one of the four categories
dge_function_highlighted <- dge_all_NEOs %>%
  filter(
    Highlight_function
  )

# ============================================================
# Interactive volcano plot
#
# Functional category = fill color
# NEO condition       = point shape
# Other significant   = dark gray
# Nonsignificant      = light gray
# ============================================================

all_NEOs_volcano <- ggplot(
  dge_all_NEOs,
  aes(
    x = logFC,
    y = -log10(FDR_plot)
  )
) +

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Nonsignificant background
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  geom_point_interactive(
    data = dge_nonsignificant,
    aes(
      tooltip = info,
      data_id = point_id
    ),
    shape = 19,
    size = 1,
    color = "gray80",
    alpha = 0.25
  ) +

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Significant but uncategorized genes
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  geom_point_interactive(
    data = dge_other_significant,
    aes(
      shape = NEO,
      tooltip = info,
      data_id = point_id
    ),
    size = 2,
    fill = "gray35",
    color = "gray20",
    stroke = 0.35,
    alpha = 0.75
  ) +

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # logFC thresholds at -2 and +2
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  geom_vline(
    xintercept = c(
      -plot_logFC_threshold,
      plot_logFC_threshold
    ),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "gray40"
  ) +

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # FDR threshold
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  geom_hline(
    yintercept = -log10(
      FDR_threshold
    ),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "gray40"
  ) +

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Significant genes matching functional categories
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  geom_point_interactive(
    data = dge_function_highlighted,
    aes(
      fill = Function_category,
      shape = NEO,
      tooltip = info,
      data_id = point_id
    ),
    size = 3,
    color = "black",
    stroke = 0.45,
    alpha = 0.95
  ) +

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Functional-category colors
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Functional category",
    values = c(
      "Envelope and membrane stress" =
        "#D73027",

      "Stress response and global regulation" =
        "#7B3294",

      "Membrane and periplasmic transport" =
        "#0571B0",

      "Carbon, amino-acid and nucleotide metabolism" =
        "#1A9850"
    ),
    drop = TRUE
  ) +

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # NEO-condition shapes
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  scale_shape_manual(
    name = "NEO condition",
    values = c(
      "KpnNEO" = 21,
      "C3.1bNEO" = 24,
      "C4.1bNEO" = 22,
      "C7.6bNEO" = 23
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +

  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
      order = 1,
      override.aes = list(
        shape = 21,
        size = 4,
        color = "black",
        alpha = 1
      )
    ),

    shape = guide_legend(
      order = 2,
      override.aes = list(
        fill = "white",
        color = "black",
        size = 4,
        alpha = 1
      )
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Functional Responses Across NEO Conditions",

    x = expression(
      log[2] * "(expression fold change)"
    ),

    y = expression(
      -log[10] * "(FDR)"
    )
  ) +

  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1 / 2,

    legend.position = "right",

    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold",
      size = 13
    ),

    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

    panel.background = element_rect(
      fill = "white",
      colour = "black"
    ),

    text = element_text(
      size = 12
    ),

    axis.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 12
    ),

    legend.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 11
    ),

    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 9
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# Display static plot
# ============================================================

print(
  all_NEOs_volcano
)

# ============================================================
# Display interactive plot in the RStudio Viewer
#
# No HTML file is written.

all_NEOs_volcano_interactive <- girafe(
```

```{r}
library(edgeR)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)
library(stringr)

# ============================================================
# Settings
# ============================================================

annotation_file <- "./data/input/Annotations.csv"

plot_logFC_threshold <- 4
FDR_threshold <- 0.05

# ============================================================
# Check required objects
# ============================================================

required_objects <- c(
  "y",
  "design"
)

missing_objects <- required_objects[
  !vapply(
    required_objects,
    exists,
    logical(1),
    inherits = TRUE
  )
]

if (length(missing_objects) > 0) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "Missing required object(s): ",
      paste(
        missing_objects,
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  )
}

if (!file.exists(annotation_file)) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "Annotation file was not found: ",
      annotation_file
    )
  )
}

# ============================================================
# Read annotation file
#
# The annotation file is expected to be a headerless,
# nine-column GFF-style CSV file.
# ============================================================

annotation_raw <- read.csv(
  annotation_file,
  header = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE,
  quote = "\"",
  comment.char = ""
)

if (ncol(annotation_raw) != 9) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "The annotation file should contain 9 columns, but ",
      ncol(annotation_raw),
      " columns were detected."
    )
  )
}

colnames(annotation_raw) <- c(
  "seqid",
  "description",
  "feature_type",
  "start",
  "end",
  "score",
  "strand",
  "phase",
  "attributes"
)

# ============================================================
# Extract one attribute from the GFF attributes column
# ============================================================

extract_attribute <- function(
    attributes,
    key
) {

  attributes <- as.character(
    attributes
  )

  pattern <- paste0(
    "(?:^|;)",
    key,
    "=([^;]+)"
  )

  value <- str_match(
    attributes,
    pattern
  )[, 2]

  value <- str_replace_all(
    value,
    regex(
      "%2C",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    ","
  )

  value <- str_replace_all(
    value,
    regex(
      "%3B",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    ";"
  )

  value <- str_replace_all(
    value,
    regex(
      "%28",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    "("
  )

  value <- str_replace_all(
    value,
    regex(
      "%29",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    ")"
  )

  value <- str_replace_all(
    value,
    regex(
      "%2B",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    "+"
  )

  value <- str_replace_all(
    value,
    "\u00A0",
    " "
  )

  str_squish(
    value
  )
}

# ============================================================
# Parse structured annotation fields
# ============================================================

annotation_parsed <- annotation_raw %>%
  mutate(
    gene = extract_attribute(
      attributes,
      "gene"
    ),

    locus_tag = extract_attribute(
      attributes,
      "locus_tag"
    ),

    product = extract_attribute(
      attributes,
      "product"
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# Return the first nonmissing annotation for each locus
# ============================================================

first_nonmissing <- function(x) {

  x <- as.character(
    x
  )

  x <- x[
    !is.na(x) &
      x != ""
  ]

  if (length(x) == 0) {
    return("N/A")
  }

  x[1]
}

# ============================================================
# Collapse annotation rows into one row per locus tag
# ============================================================

MG1655_annotation <- annotation_parsed %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(locus_tag),
    locus_tag != ""
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    locus_tag
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    chr = first_nonmissing(
      seqid
    ),

    gene = first_nonmissing(
      gene
    ),

    product = first_nonmissing(
      product
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rename(
    GeneID = locus_tag
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    GeneID = as.character(
      GeneID
    ),

    gene_lower = tolower(
      str_squish(
        gene
      )
    ),

    product_lower = tolower(
      str_squish(
        product
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    GeneID,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )

# ============================================================
# Functional classification
#
# Uses:
#   1. Exact gene-name matches.
#   2. Specific product/family-description matches.
#
# Example:
#   gene    = yjfJ
#   product = PspA family protein YjfJ
#
# This is classified as:
#   Envelope and membrane stress
# ============================================================

classify_function <- function(
    gene_lower,
    product_lower
) {

  gene_lower <- ifelse(
    is.na(gene_lower),
    "",
    tolower(
      gene_lower
    )
  )

  product_lower <- ifelse(
    is.na(product_lower),
    "",
    tolower(
      product_lower
    )
  )

  case_when(

    # ========================================================
    # Envelope and membrane stress
    # ========================================================

    gene_lower %in% c(
      "pspa",
      "pspb",
      "pspc",
      "pspd",
      "pspe",
      "pspg",
      "cpxp",
      "yagu",
      "yjfj",
      "osmb",
      "bsma",
      "yiad",
      "alx",
      "asr",
      "lpxc",
      "yqae",
      "bord",
      "atpi"
    ) ~

      "Envelope and membrane stress",

    str_detect(
      product_lower,
      paste0(
        "\\bpspa family protein\\b|",
        "\\bphage shock protein a\\b|",
        "\\bphage shock protein b\\b|",
        "\\bphage shock protein c\\b|",
        "\\bphage shock protein d\\b|",
        "\\bphage shock protein e\\b|",
        "\\bphage shock protein g\\b|",
        "\\bperiplasmic protein cpxp\\b|",
        "\\bosmotically[- ]inducible lipoprotein\\b|",
        "\\bmembrane[- ]bound redox modulator\\b|",
        "\\bperiplasmic chaperone asr\\b|",
        "\\bduf1471 domain[- ]containing putative lipoprotein\\b|",
        "\\bpf13488 family lipoprotein\\b|",
        "\\budp-3-o-acyl-n-acetylglucosamine deacetylase\\b|",
        "\\batp synthase accessory factor atpi\\b"
      )
    ) ~

      "Envelope and membrane stress",

    # ========================================================
    # Stress response and global regulation
    # ========================================================

    gene_lower %in% c(
      "soxs",
      "ibpa",
      "ibpb",
      "ytfk",
      "dusb",
      "fis",
      "mara",
      "marr",
      "marb",
      "rpoh",
      "iscr",
      "nahr",
      "soda",
      "trxc",
      "nrdh",
      "nrdi",
      "cyar",
      "glmz",
      "rbsz",
      "rttr",
      "dksa",
      "grea",
      "dead",
      "obge",
      "yjfn",
      "yjhq",
      "chps",
      "slyx",
      "yhab"
    ) ~

      "Stress response and global regulation",

    str_detect(
      product_lower,
      paste0(
        "\\bdna-binding transcriptional dual regulator soxs\\b|",
        "\\brna polymerase sigma factor rpoh\\b|",
        "\\bstringent response modulator ytfk\\b|",
        "\\bsuperoxide dismutase \\(mn\\)\\b|",
        "\\bglutaredoxin-like protein nrdh\\b|",
        "\\breduced thioredoxin 2\\b|",
        "\\bdimanganese-tyrosyl radical cofactor maintenance flavodoxin nrdi\\b|",
        "\\btranscription elongation factor grea\\b|",
        "\\brna polymerase-binding transcription factor dksa\\b|",
        "\\buniversal stress protein\\b|",
        "\\bstress-induced protein\\b|",
        "\\bstress response protein\\b|",
        "\\bsmall regulatory rna cyar\\b|",
        "\\bsmall regulatory rna glmz\\b|",
        "\\bsmall regulatory rna rbsz\\b|",
        "\\bsmall rna rttr\\b"
      )
    ) ~

      "Stress response and global regulation",

    # ========================================================
    # Membrane and periplasmic transport
    # ========================================================

    gene_lower %in% c(
      "rbsa",
      "rbsb",

# ============================================================
# Fit edgeR model
# ============================================================

fit <- glmQLFit(
  y,
  design
)

# ============================================================
# Run only the KpnNEO versus EGFP contrast
#
# Positive logFC means higher expression in KpnNEO relative
# to EGFP.
# ============================================================

KpnNEO_test <- glmQLFTest(
  fit,
  contrast = c(
    -1,
    1,
    0,
    0,
    0
  )
)

dge_KpnNEO <- topTags(
  KpnNEO_test,
  n = Inf,
  adjust.method = "BH",
  sort.by = "PValue",
  p.value = 1
)$table %>%
  rownames_to_column(
    "GeneID"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    GeneID = as.character(
      GeneID
    )
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    MG1655_annotation,
    by = "GeneID"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    NEO = "KpnNEO",

    gene = if_else(
      is.na(gene) |
        gene == "",
      "N/A",
      gene
    ),

    product = if_else(
      is.na(product) |
        product == "",
      "N/A",
      product
    ),

    chr = if_else(
      is.na(chr) |
        chr == "",
      "N/A",
      chr
    ),

    gene_lower = tolower(
      str_squish(
        gene
      )
    ),

    product_lower = tolower(
      str_squish(
        product
      )
    ),

    FDR_plot = pmax(
      FDR,
      .Machine$double.xmin
    ),

    Significant = (
      abs(logFC) >= plot_logFC_threshold &
        FDR < FDR_threshold
    ),

    Direction = case_when(
      Significant &
        logFC >= plot_logFC_threshold ~
        "Upregulated",

      Significant &
        logFC <= -plot_logFC_threshold ~
        "Downregulated",

      TRUE ~
        "Not significant"
    ),

    Function_category = classify_function(
      gene_lower = gene_lower,
      product_lower = product_lower
    ),

    Highlight_function = (
      Significant &
        !is.na(Function_category)
    ),

    Function_category = factor(
      Function_category,
      levels = c(
        "Envelope and membrane stress",
        "Stress response and global regulation",
        "Membrane and periplasmic transport",
        "Carbon, amino-acid and nucleotide metabolism"
      )
    ),

    point_id = paste(
      NEO,
      GeneID,
      sep = "_"
    ),

    info = paste0(
      "Condition: KpnNEO",
      " | gene: ", gene,
      " | product: ", product,
      " | locus_tag: ", GeneID,
      " | logFC: ", round(logFC, 4),
      " | FDR: ", signif(FDR, 4),
      " | direction: ", Direction,
      " | category: ",
      if_else(
        is.na(Function_category),
        "Other",
        as.character(Function_category)
      )
    )
  )

# Preserve the previous dataframe naming convention
dge_EGFP_v_KpnNEO <- dge_KpnNEO

# ============================================================
# Separate plotting layers
# ============================================================

# Genes below the logFC and/or FDR thresholds
dge_KpnNEO_nonsignificant <- dge_KpnNEO %>%
  filter(
    !Significant
  )

# Significant genes not assigned to one of the four categories
dge_KpnNEO_other_significant <- dge_KpnNEO %>%
  filter(
    Significant,
    is.na(Function_category)
  )

# Significant genes assigned to a functional category
dge_KpnNEO_function_highlighted <- dge_KpnNEO %>%
  filter(
    Highlight_function
  )

# ============================================================
# KpnNEO volcano plot
#
# Functional category = fill color
# Other significant   = dark gray
# Nonsignificant      = light gray
#
# All points use the same shape because only KpnNEO is plotted.
# ============================================================

KpnNEO_volcano <- ggplot(
  dge_KpnNEO,
  aes(
    x = logFC,
    y = -log10(FDR_plot)
  )
) +

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Nonsignificant genes
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  geom_point_interactive(
    data = dge_KpnNEO_nonsignificant,
    aes(
      tooltip = info,
      data_id = point_id
    ),
    shape = 21,
    size = 1.3,
    fill = "gray80",
    color = "gray70",
    stroke = 0.15,
    alpha = 0.30
  ) +

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Significant uncategorized genes
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  geom_point_interactive(
    data = dge_KpnNEO_other_significant,
    aes(
      tooltip = info,
      data_id = point_id
    ),
    shape = 21,
    size = 2.2,
    fill = "gray80",
    color = "gray70",
    stroke = 0.35,
    alpha = 0.80
  ) +

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # logFC thresholds at -2 and +2
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  geom_vline(
    xintercept = c(
      -plot_logFC_threshold,
      plot_logFC_threshold
    ),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "gray40"
  ) +

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # FDR threshold
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  geom_hline(
    yintercept = -log10(
      FDR_threshold
    ),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "gray40"
  ) +

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Significant functionally categorized genes
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  geom_point_interactive(
    data = dge_KpnNEO_function_highlighted,
    aes(
      fill = Function_category,
      tooltip = info,
      data_id = point_id
    ),
    shape = 21,
    size = 3.2,
    color = "black",
    stroke = 0.45,
    alpha = 0.95
  ) +

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Functional-category colors
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Functional category",
    values = c(
      "Envelope and membrane stress" =
        "lightblue",

      "Stress response and global regulation" =
        "darkgreen",

      "Membrane and periplasmic transport" =
        "maroon",

      "Carbon, amino-acid and nucleotide metabolism" =
        "orange"
    ),
    drop = TRUE
  ) +

  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(
        shape = 21,
        size = 4,
        color = "black",
        alpha = 1
      )
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "KpnNEO vs. EGFP",

    x = expression(
      log[2] * "(expression fold change)"
    ),

    y = expression(
      -log[10] * "(FDR)"
    )
  ) +

  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1 / 2,

    legend.position = "right",

    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold",
      size = 13
    ),

    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

    panel.background = element_rect(
      fill = "white",
      colour = "black"
    ),

    text = element_text(
      size = 12
    ),

    axis.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 12
    ),

    legend.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 11
    ),

    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 9
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# Display static plot
# ============================================================

print(
  KpnNEO_volcano
)

# ============================================================
# Display interactive plot in the RStudio Viewer
#
# No output file is created.
# ============================================================

KpnNEO_volcano_interactive <- girafe(
  ggobj = KpnNEO_volcano,
  width_svg = 10,
  height_svg = 5.8,
  options = list(
    opts_hover(
      css = paste0(
        "stroke:black;",
        "stroke-width:1.5px;"
      )
    ),

    opts_selection(
      type = "single",
      css = paste0(
        "stroke:black;",
        "stroke-width:2px;"
      )
    ),

    opts_tooltip(
      opacity = 0.95,
      use_fill = TRUE,
      use_stroke = TRUE,
      css = paste0(
        "background-color:black;",
        "color:white;",
        "padding:8px;",
        "border-radius:3px;",
        "font-size:12px;",
        "max-width:700px;",
        "white-space:normal;"
      )
    )
  )
)
```

```{r}
library(edgeR)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)
library(stringr)

# ============================================================
# Settings
# ============================================================

annotation_file <- "./data/input/Annotations.csv"

plot_logFC_threshold <- 2
FDR_threshold <- 0.05

# ============================================================
# Check required objects
# ============================================================

required_objects <- c(
  "y",
  "design"
)

missing_objects <- required_objects[
  !vapply(
    required_objects,
    exists,
    logical(1),
    inherits = TRUE
  )
]

if (length(missing_objects) > 0) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "Missing required object(s): ",
      paste(
        missing_objects,
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  )
}

if (!file.exists(annotation_file)) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "Annotation file was not found: ",
      annotation_file
    )
  )
}

# ============================================================
# Read annotation file
#
# The annotation file is expected to be a headerless,
# nine-column GFF-style CSV file.
# ============================================================

annotation_raw <- read.csv(
  annotation_file,
  header = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE,
  quote = "\"",
  comment.char = ""
)

if (ncol(annotation_raw) != 9) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "The annotation file should contain 9 columns, but ",
      ncol(annotation_raw),
      " columns were detected."
    )
  )
}

colnames(annotation_raw) <- c(
  "seqid",
  "description",
  "feature_type",
  "start",
  "end",
  "score",
  "strand",
  "phase",
  "attributes"
)

# ============================================================
# Extract one attribute from the GFF attributes column
# ============================================================

extract_attribute <- function(
    attributes,
    key
) {

  attributes <- as.character(
    attributes
  )

  pattern <- paste0(
    "(?:^|;)",
    key,
    "=([^;]+)"
  )

  value <- str_match(
    attributes,
    pattern
  )[, 2]

  value <- str_replace_all(
    value,
    regex(
      "%2C",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    ","
  )

  value <- str_replace_all(
    value,
    regex(
      "%3B",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    ";"
  )

  value <- str_replace_all(
    value,
    regex(
      "%28",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    "("
  )

  value <- str_replace_all(
    value,
    regex(
      "%29",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    ")"
  )

  value <- str_replace_all(
    value,
    regex(
      "%2B",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    "+"
  )

  value <- str_replace_all(
    value,
    "\u00A0",
    " "
  )

  str_squish(
    value
  )
}

# ============================================================
# Parse structured annotation fields
# ============================================================

annotation_parsed <- annotation_raw %>%
  mutate(
    gene = extract_attribute(
      attributes,
      "gene"
    ),

    locus_tag = extract_attribute(
      attributes,
      "locus_tag"
    ),

    product = extract_attribute(
      attributes,
      "product"
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# Return the first nonmissing annotation for each locus
# ============================================================

first_nonmissing <- function(x) {

  x <- as.character(
    x
  )

  x <- x[
    !is.na(x) &
      x != ""
  ]

  if (length(x) == 0) {
    return("N/A")
  }

  x[1]
}

# ============================================================
# Collapse annotation rows into one row per locus tag
# ============================================================

MG1655_annotation <- annotation_parsed %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(locus_tag),
    locus_tag != ""
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    locus_tag
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    chr = first_nonmissing(
      seqid
    ),

    gene = first_nonmissing(
      gene
    ),

    product = first_nonmissing(
      product
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rename(
    GeneID = locus_tag
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    GeneID = as.character(
      GeneID
    ),

    gene_lower = tolower(
      str_squish(
        gene
      )
    ),

    product_lower = tolower(
      str_squish(
        product
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    GeneID,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )

# ============================================================
# Functional classification
#
# Uses:
#   1. Exact gene-name matches.
#   2. Specific product/family-description matches.
#
# Categories:
#   1. Envelope and membrane stress
#   2. Stress response and regulation
#   3. Membrane and periplasmic transport
#   4. Energy and nucleotide homeostasis
#
# Example:
#   gene    = yjfJ
#   product = PspA family protein YjfJ
#
# This is classified as:
#   Envelope and membrane stress
# ============================================================

classify_function <- function(
    gene_lower,
    product_lower
) {

  gene_lower <- ifelse(
    is.na(gene_lower),
    "",
    tolower(
      gene_lower
    )
  )

  product_lower <- ifelse(
    is.na(product_lower),
    "",
    tolower(
      product_lower
    )
  )

  case_when(

    # ========================================================
    # Envelope and membrane stress
    # ========================================================

    gene_lower %in% c(
      "pspa",
      "pspb",
      "pspc",
      "pspd",
      "pspe",
      "pspg",
      "cpxp",
      "yagu",
      "yjfj",
      "osmb",
      "bsma",
      "yiad",
      "alx",
      "asr",
      "lpxc",
      "yqae",
      "bord",
      "atpi"
    ) ~

      "Envelope and membrane stress",

    str_detect(
      product_lower,
      paste0(
        "\\bpspa family protein\\b|",
        "\\bphage shock protein a\\b|",
        "\\bphage shock protein b\\b|",
        "\\bphage shock protein c\\b|",
        "\\bphage shock protein d\\b|",
        "\\bphage shock protein e\\b|",
        "\\bphage shock protein g\\b|",
        "\\bperiplasmic protein cpxp\\b|",
        "\\bosmotically[- ]inducible lipoprotein\\b|",
        "\\bmembrane[- ]bound redox modulator\\b|",
        "\\bperiplasmic chaperone asr\\b|",
        "\\bduf1471 domain[- ]containing putative lipoprotein\\b|",
        "\\bpf13488 family lipoprotein\\b|",
        "\\budp-3-o-acyl-n-acetylglucosamine deacetylase\\b|",
        "\\batp synthase accessory factor atpi\\b"

    ) ~

      "Envelope and membrane stress",

    # ========================================================

    gene_lower %in% c(

        "\\bmg\\(2\\(\\+\\)\\) importing p-type atpase\\b|",
        "\\bzn\\(2\\(\\+\\)\\)/cd\\(2\\(\\+\\)\\)/pb\\(2\\(\\+\\)\\) exporting p-type atpase\\b|",
        "\\bputative transporter yhjx\\b|",
        "\\bputative transporter yhbe\\b|",
        "\\bputative transporter yihn\\b|",
        "\\bfructose-specific pts multiphosphoryl transfer protein frua\\b"
      )
    ) ~

      "Membrane and periplasmic transport",

    # ========================================================
    # Energy and nucleotide homeostasis
    #
    # This category is restricted to genes associated with:
    #   - ATP, GTP, CTP, or nucleotide-pool maintenance
    #   - Purine or pyrimidine salvage/biosynthesis
    #   - Major energy-generating or energy-coupled pathways
    #
    # General carbon- and amino-acid-metabolism genes that do
    # not directly support this interpretation are excluded.
    # ========================================================

    gene_lower %in% c(
      "apt",
      "deob",
      "ndk",
      "gmk",
      "cmk",
      "cara",
      "carb",
      "acs",
      "fadb",
      "fuma",
      "fumc",
      "pfla",
      "lpda"
    ) ~

      "Energy and nucleotide homeostasis",

    str_detect(
      product_lower,
      paste0(
        "\\badenine phosphoribosyltransferase\\b|",
        "\\bphosphopentomutase\\b|",
        "\\bnucleoside diphosphate kinase\\b|",
        "\\bguanylate kinase\\b|",
        "\\bcytidylate kinase\\b|",
        "\\bcarbamoyl-phosphate synthetase small subunit\\b|",
        "\\bcarbamoyl-phosphate synthetase large subunit\\b|",
        "\\bacetyl-coa synthetase \\(amp-forming\\)\\b|",
        "\\bfatty acid oxidation complex subunit alpha\\b|",
        "\\bfatty acid oxidation complex subunit fadb\\b|",
        "\\bfumarase a\\b|",
        "\\bfumarase c\\b|",
        "\\bpyruvate formate-lyase activating enzyme\\b|",
        "\\blipoamide dehydrogenase\\b"
      )
    ) ~

      "Energy and nucleotide homeostasis",

    TRUE ~
      NA_character_
  )
}

# ============================================================
# Fit edgeR model
# ============================================================

fit <- glmQLFit(
  y,
  design
)

# ============================================================
# Run only the KpnNEO versus EGFP contrast
#
# Positive logFC means higher expression in KpnNEO relative
# to EGFP.
# ============================================================

KpnNEO_test <- glmQLFTest(
  fit,
  contrast = c(
    -1,
    1,
    0,
    0,
    0
  )
)

dge_KpnNEO <- topTags(
  KpnNEO_test,
  n = Inf,
  adjust.method = "BH",
  sort.by = "PValue",
  p.value = 1
)$table %>%
  rownames_to_column(
    "GeneID"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    GeneID = as.character(
      GeneID
    )
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    MG1655_annotation,
    by = "GeneID"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    NEO = "KpnNEO",

    gene = if_else(
      is.na(gene) |
        gene == "",
      "N/A",
      gene
    ),

    product = if_else(
      is.na(product) |
        product == "",
      "N/A",
      product
    ),

    chr = if_else(
      is.na(chr) |
        chr == "",
      "N/A",
      chr
    ),

    gene_lower = tolower(
      str_squish(
        gene
      )
    ),

    product_lower = tolower(
      str_squish(
        product
      )
    ),

    FDR_plot = pmax(
      FDR,
      .Machine$double.xmin
    ),

    Significant = (
      abs(logFC) >= plot_logFC_threshold &
        FDR < FDR_threshold
    ),

    Direction = case_when(
      Significant &
        logFC >= plot_logFC_threshold ~
        "Upregulated",

      Significant &
        logFC <= -plot_logFC_threshold ~
        "Downregulated",

      TRUE ~
        "Not significant"
    ),

    Function_category = classify_function(
      gene_lower = gene_lower,
      product_lower = product_lower
    ),

    Highlight_function = (
      Significant &
        !is.na(Function_category)
    ),

    Function_category = factor(
      Function_category,
      levels = c(
        "Envelope and membrane stress",
        "Stress response and regulation",
        "Membrane and periplasmic transport",
        "Energy and nucleotide homeostasis"
      )
    ),

    point_id = paste(
      NEO,
      GeneID,
      sep = "_"
    ),

    info = paste0(
      "Condition: KpnNEO",
      " | gene: ", gene,
      " | product: ", product,
      " | locus_tag: ", GeneID,
      " | logFC: ", round(logFC, 4),
      " | FDR: ", signif(FDR, 4),
      " | direction: ", Direction,
      " | category: ",
      if_else(
        is.na(Function_category),
        "Other",
        as.character(Function_category)
      )
    )
  )

# Preserve the previous dataframe naming convention
dge_EGFP_v_KpnNEO <- dge_KpnNEO

# ============================================================
# Separate plotting layers
# ============================================================

# Genes below the logFC and/or FDR thresholds
dge_KpnNEO_nonsignificant <- dge_KpnNEO %>%
  filter(
    !Significant
  )

# Significant genes not assigned to one of the four categories
dge_KpnNEO_other_significant <- dge_KpnNEO %>%
  filter(
    Significant,
    is.na(Function_category)
  )

# Significant genes assigned to a functional category
dge_KpnNEO_function_highlighted <- dge_KpnNEO %>%
  filter(
    Highlight_function
  )

# ============================================================
# KpnNEO volcano plot
#
# Functional category = fill color
# Other significant   = gray
# Nonsignificant      = light gray
#
# All points use the same shape because only KpnNEO is plotted.
# ============================================================

KpnNEO_volcano <- ggplot(
  dge_KpnNEO,
  aes(
    x = logFC,
    y = -log10(FDR_plot)
  )
) +

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Nonsignificant genes
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  geom_point_interactive(
    data = dge_KpnNEO_nonsignificant,
    aes(
      tooltip = info,
      data_id = point_id
    ),
    shape = 21,
    size = 1.3,
    fill = "gray80",
    color = "gray70",
    stroke = 0.15,
    alpha = 0.30
  ) +

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Significant uncategorized genes
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  geom_point_interactive(
    data = dge_KpnNEO_other_significant,
    aes(
      tooltip = info,
      data_id = point_id
    ),
    shape = 21,
    size = 2.2,
    fill = "gray80",
    color = "gray70",
    stroke = 0.35,
    alpha = 0.80
  ) +

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # logFC thresholds at -4 and +4
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  geom_vline(
    xintercept = c(
      -plot_logFC_threshold,
      plot_logFC_threshold
    ),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "gray40"
  ) +

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # FDR threshold
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  geom_hline(
    yintercept = -log10(
      FDR_threshold
    ),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "gray40"
  ) +

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Significant functionally categorized genes
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  geom_point_interactive(
    data = dge_KpnNEO_function_highlighted,
    aes(
      fill = Function_category,
      tooltip = info,
      data_id = point_id
    ),
    shape = 21,
    size = 3.2,
    color = "black",
    stroke = 0.45,
    alpha = 0.95
  ) +

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Functional-category colors
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Functional category",
    values = c(
      "Envelope and membrane stress" =
        "lightblue",

      "Stress response and regulation" =
        "darkgreen",

      "Membrane and periplasmic transport" =
        "maroon",

      "Energy and nucleotide homeostasis" =
        "orange"
    ),
    drop = TRUE
  ) +

  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(
        shape = 21,
        size = 4,
        color = "black",
        alpha = 1
      )
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "KpnNEO vs. EGFP",

    x = expression(
      log[2] * "(expression fold change)"
    ),

    y = expression(
      -log[10] * "(FDR)"
    )
  ) +

  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1 / 2,

    legend.position = "right",

    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold",
      size = 13
    ),

    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

    panel.background = element_rect(
      fill = "white",
      colour = "black"
    ),

    text = element_text(
      size = 12
    ),

    axis.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 12
    ),

    legend.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 11
    ),

    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 9
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# Display static plot
# ============================================================

print(
  KpnNEO_volcano
)

# ============================================================
# Display interactive plot in the RStudio Viewer
#
# No output file is created.
# ============================================================

KpnNEO_volcano_interactive <- girafe(
  ggobj = KpnNEO_volcano,
  width_svg = 10,
  height_svg = 5.8,
  options = list(
    opts_hover(
      css = paste0(
        "stroke:black;",
        "stroke-width:1.5px;"
      )
    ),

    opts_selection(
      type = "single",
      css = paste0(
        "stroke:black;",
        "stroke-width:2px;"
      )
    ),

    opts_tooltip(
      opacity = 0.95,
      use_fill = TRUE,
      use_stroke = TRUE,
      css = paste0(
        "background-color:black;",
        "color:white;",
        "padding:8px;",
        "border-radius:3px;",
        "font-size:12px;",
        "max-width:700px;",
        "white-space:normal;"
      )
    )
  )
)
```

```{r}
library(edgeR)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)
library(stringr)

# ============================================================
# Settings
# ============================================================

annotation_file <- "./data/input/Annotations.csv"

plot_logFC_threshold <- 2
FDR_threshold <- 0.05

# ============================================================
# Check required objects
# ============================================================

required_objects <- c(
  "y",
  "design"
)

missing_objects <- required_objects[
  !vapply(
    required_objects,
    exists,
    logical(1),
    inherits = TRUE
  )
]

if (length(missing_objects) > 0) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "Missing required object(s): ",
      paste(
        missing_objects,
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  )
}

if (!file.exists(annotation_file)) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "Annotation file was not found: ",
      annotation_file
    )
  )
}

# ============================================================
# Read annotation file
#
# The annotation file is expected to be a headerless,
# nine-column GFF-style CSV file.
# ============================================================

annotation_raw <- read.csv(
  annotation_file,
  header = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE,
  quote = "\"",
  comment.char = ""
)

if (ncol(annotation_raw) != 9) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "The annotation file should contain 9 columns, but ",
      ncol(annotation_raw),
      " columns were detected."
    )
  )
}

colnames(annotation_raw) <- c(
  "seqid",
  "description",
  "feature_type",
  "start",
  "end",
  "score",
  "strand",
  "phase",
  "attributes"
)

# ============================================================
# Extract one attribute from the GFF attributes column
# ============================================================

extract_attribute <- function(
    attributes,
    key
) {

  attributes <- as.character(
    attributes
  )

  pattern <- paste0(
    "(?:^|;)",
    key,
    "=([^;]+)"
  )

  value <- str_match(
    attributes,
    pattern
  )[, 2]

  value <- str_replace_all(
    value,
    regex(
      "%2C",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    ","
  )

  value <- str_replace_all(
    value,
    regex(
      "%3B",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    ";"
  )

  value <- str_replace_all(
    value,
    regex(
      "%28",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    "("
  )

  value <- str_replace_all(
    value,
    regex(
      "%29",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    ")"
  )

  value <- str_replace_all(
    value,
    regex(
      "%2B",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    "+"
  )

  value <- str_replace_all(
    value,
    "\u00A0",
    " "
  )

  str_squish(
    value
  )
}

# ============================================================
# Parse structured annotation fields
# ============================================================

annotation_parsed <- annotation_raw %>%
  mutate(
    gene = extract_attribute(
      attributes,
      "gene"
    ),

    locus_tag = extract_attribute(
      attributes,
      "locus_tag"
    ),

    product = extract_attribute(
      attributes,
      "product"
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# Return the first nonmissing annotation for each locus
# ============================================================

first_nonmissing <- function(x) {

  x <- as.character(
    x
  )

  x <- x[
    !is.na(x) &
      x != ""
  ]

  if (length(x) == 0) {
    return("N/A")
  }

  x[1]
}

# ============================================================
# Collapse annotation rows into one row per locus tag
# ============================================================

MG1655_annotation <- annotation_parsed %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(locus_tag),
    locus_tag != ""
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    locus_tag
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    chr = first_nonmissing(
      seqid
    ),

    gene = first_nonmissing(
      gene
    ),

    product = first_nonmissing(
      product
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rename(
    GeneID = locus_tag
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    GeneID = as.character(
      GeneID
    ),

    gene_lower = tolower(
      str_squish(
        gene
      )
    ),

    product_lower = tolower(
      str_squish(
        product
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    GeneID,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )

# ============================================================
# Functional classification
#
# Categories:
#   1. Envelope and membrane stress
#   2. Stress response and regulation
#   3. Membrane and periplasmic transport
#   4. Energy and nucleotide homeostasis
# ============================================================

classify_function <- function(
    gene_lower,
    product_lower
) {

  gene_lower <- ifelse(
    is.na(gene_lower),
    "",
    tolower(
      gene_lower
    )
  )

  product_lower <- ifelse(
    is.na(product_lower),
    "",
    tolower(
      product_lower
    )
  )

  case_when(

    # ========================================================
    # Envelope and membrane stress
    # ========================================================

    gene_lower %in% c(
      "pspa",
      "pspb",
      "pspc",
      "pspd",
      "pspe",
      "pspg",
      "cpxp",
      "yagu",
      "yjfj",
      "osmb",
      "bsma",
      "yiad",
      "alx",
      "asr",
      "lpxc",
      "yqae",
      "bord",
      "atpi"
    ) ~

      "Envelope and membrane stress",

    str_detect(

        "\\bphage shock protein b\\b|",
        "\\bphage shock protein c\\b|",

        "\\bperiplasmic chaperone asr\\b|",
        "\\bduf1471 domain[- ]containing putative lipoprotein\\b|",
        "\\bpf13488 family lipoprotein\\b|",
        "\\budp-3-o-acyl-n-acetylglucosamine deacetylase\\b|",
        "\\batp synthase accessory factor atpi\\b"
      )
    ) ~

      "Envelope and membrane stress",

    # ========================================================

    # ========================================================

    gene_lower %in% c(

    ) ~

    # ========================================================

    gene_lower %in% c(

    ) ~

  )
}

# ============================================================
# Fit edgeR model
# ============================================================

fit <- glmQLFit(
  y,
  design
)

# ============================================================
# Run C3.1bNEO versus EGFP contrast
#
# Assumed design-column order:
#   1. EGFP
#   2. KpnNEO
#   3. C3.1bNEO
#   4. C4.1bNEO
#   5. C7.6bNEO
#
# Positive logFC means higher expression in C3.1bNEO
# relative to EGFP.
# ============================================================

C3_1bNEO_test <- glmQLFTest(
  fit,
  contrast = c(
    -1,
    0,
    1,
    0,
    0
  )
)

dge_C3_1bNEO <- topTags(
  C3_1bNEO_test,
  n = Inf,
  adjust.method = "BH",
  sort.by = "PValue",
  p.value = 1
)$table %>%
  rownames_to_column(
    "GeneID"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    GeneID = as.character(
      GeneID
    )
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    MG1655_annotation,
    by = "GeneID"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    NEO = "C3.1bNEO",

    gene = if_else(
      is.na(gene) |
        gene == "",
      "N/A",
      gene
    ),

    product = if_else(
      is.na(product) |
        product == "",
      "N/A",
      product
    ),

    chr = if_else(
      is.na(chr) |
        chr == "",
      "N/A",
      chr
    ),

    gene_lower = tolower(
      str_squish(
        gene
      )
    ),

    product_lower = tolower(
      str_squish(
        product
      )
    ),

    FDR_plot = pmax(
      FDR,
      .Machine$double.xmin
    ),

    Significant = (
      abs(logFC) >= plot_logFC_threshold &
        FDR < FDR_threshold
    ),

    Direction = case_when(
      Significant &
        logFC >= plot_logFC_threshold ~
        "Upregulated",

      Significant &
        logFC <= -plot_logFC_threshold ~
        "Downregulated",

      TRUE ~
        "Not significant"
    ),

    Function_category = classify_function(
      gene_lower = gene_lower,
      product_lower = product_lower
    ),

    Highlight_function = (
      Significant &
        !is.na(Function_category)
    ),

    Function_category = factor(
      Function_category,
      levels = c(
        "Envelope and membrane stress",
        "Stress response and regulation",
        "Membrane and periplasmic transport",
        "Energy and nucleotide homeostasis"
      )
    ),

    point_id = paste(
      NEO,
      GeneID,
      sep = "_"
    ),

    info = paste0(
      "Condition: C3.1bNEO",
      " | gene: ", gene,
      " | product: ", product,
      " | locus_tag: ", GeneID,
      " | logFC: ", round(logFC, 4),
      " | FDR: ", signif(FDR, 4),
      " | direction: ", Direction,
      " | category: ",
      if_else(
        is.na(Function_category),
        "Other",
        as.character(Function_category)
      )
    )
  )

# Preserve the previous dataframe naming convention
dge_EGFP_v_C3_1bNEO <- dge_C3_1bNEO

# ============================================================
# Separate plotting layers
# ============================================================

dge_C3_1bNEO_nonsignificant <- dge_C3_1bNEO %>%
  filter(
    !Significant
  )

dge_C3_1bNEO_other_significant <- dge_C3_1bNEO %>%
  filter(
    Significant,
    is.na(Function_category)
  )

  )
```
