```{r}
library(edgeR)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)
library(stringr)

# ============================================================
# Settings
# ============================================================

annotation_file <- "./data/input/Annotations.csv"

plot_logFC_threshold <- 2
FDR_threshold <- 0.05

# ============================================================
# Check required objects
# ============================================================

required_objects <- c(
  "y",
  "design"
)

missing_objects <- required_objects[
  !vapply(
    required_objects,
    exists,
    logical(1),
    inherits = TRUE
  )
]

if (length(missing_objects) > 0) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "Missing required object(s): ",
      paste(
        missing_objects,
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  )
}

if (!file.exists(annotation_file)) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "Annotation file was not found: ",
      annotation_file
    )
  )
}

# ============================================================
# Read annotation file
#
# The annotation file is expected to be a headerless,
# nine-column GFF-style CSV file.
# ============================================================

annotation_raw <- read.csv(
  annotation_file,
  header = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE,
  quote = "\"",
  comment.char = ""
)

if (ncol(annotation_raw) != 9) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "The annotation file should contain 9 columns, but ",
      ncol(annotation_raw),
      " columns were detected."
    )
  )
}

colnames(annotation_raw) <- c(
  "seqid",
  "description",
  "feature_type",
  "start",
  "end",
  "score",
  "strand",
  "phase",
  "attributes"
)

# ============================================================
# Extract one attribute from the GFF attributes column
# ============================================================

extract_attribute <- function(
    attributes,
    key
) {

  attributes <- as.character(
    attributes
  )

  pattern <- paste0(
    "(?:^|;)",
    key,
    "=([^;]+)"
  )

  value <- str_match(
    attributes,
    pattern
  )[, 2]

  value <- str_replace_all(
    value,
    regex(
      "%2C",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    ","
  )

  value <- str_replace_all(
    value,
    regex(
      "%3B",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    ";"
  )

  value <- str_replace_all(
    value,
    regex(
      "%28",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    "("
  )

  value <- str_replace_all(
    value,
    regex(
      "%29",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    ")"
  )

  value <- str_replace_all(
    value,
    regex(
      "%2B",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    "+"
  )

  value <- str_replace_all(
    value,
    "\u00A0",
    " "
  )

  str_squish(
    value
  )
}

# ============================================================
# Parse structured annotation fields
# ============================================================

annotation_parsed <- annotation_raw %>%
  mutate(
    gene = extract_attribute(
      attributes,
      "gene"
    ),

    locus_tag = extract_attribute(
      attributes,
      "locus_tag"
    ),

    product = extract_attribute(
      attributes,
      "product"
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# Return the first nonmissing annotation for each locus
# ============================================================

first_nonmissing <- function(x) {

  x <- as.character(
    x
  )

  x <- x[
    !is.na(x) &
      x != ""
  ]

  if (length(x) == 0) {
    return("N/A")
  }

  x[1]
}

# ============================================================
# Collapse annotation rows into one row per locus tag
# ============================================================

MG1655_annotation <- annotation_parsed %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(locus_tag),
    locus_tag != ""
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    locus_tag
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    chr = first_nonmissing(
      seqid
    ),

    gene = first_nonmissing(
      gene
    ),

    product = first_nonmissing(
      product
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rename(
    GeneID = locus_tag
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    GeneID = as.character(
      GeneID
    ),

    gene_lower = tolower(
      str_squish(
        gene
      )
    ),

    product_lower = tolower(
      str_squish(
        product
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    GeneID,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )

# ============================================================
# Functional classification
#
# Categories:
#   1. Envelope and membrane stress
#   2. Stress response and regulation
#   3. Membrane and periplasmic transport
#   4. Energy and nucleotide homeostasis
# ============================================================

classify_function <- function(
    gene_lower,

) {

  gene_lower <- ifelse(
    is.na(gene_lower),
    "",
    tolower(

    )
  )

  product_lower <- ifelse(
    is.na(product_lower),
    "",
    tolower(
      product_lower
    )
  )

    # ========================================================

    # ========================================================

    gene_lower %in% c(
      "pspa",
      "pspb",
      "pspc",
      "pspd",
      "pspe",

      "yjfj",

      )
    ) ~

    # ========================================================

    # ========================================================

    gene_lower %in% c(

    # ========================================================

    # ========================================================

    gene_lower %in% c(

# ============================================================
# Fit edgeR model
# ============================================================

fit <- glmQLFit(
  y,
  design
)

# ============================================================
# Run C4.1bNEO versus EGFP contrast
#
# Assumed design-column order:
#   1. EGFP
#   2. KpnNEO
#   3. C3.1bNEO
#   4. C4.1bNEO
#   5. C7.6bNEO
#
# Positive logFC means higher expression in C4.1bNEO
# relative to EGFP.
# ============================================================

C4_1bNEO_test <- glmQLFTest(
  fit,
  contrast = c(
    -1,
    0,
    0,
    1,
    0
  )
)

dge_C4_1bNEO <- topTags(
  C4_1bNEO_test,
  n = Inf,
  adjust.method = "BH",
  sort.by = "PValue",
  p.value = 1
)$table %>%
  rownames_to_column(
    "GeneID"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    GeneID = as.character(
      GeneID
    )
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    MG1655_annotation,
    by = "GeneID"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    NEO = "C4.1bNEO",

    gene = if_else(
      is.na(gene) |
        gene == "",
      "N/A",
      gene
    ),

    product = if_else(
      is.na(product) |
        product == "",
      "N/A",
      product
    ),

    chr = if_else(
      is.na(chr) |
        chr == "",
      "N/A",
      chr
    ),

    gene_lower = tolower(
      str_squish(
        gene
      )
    ),

    product_lower = tolower(
      str_squish(
        product
      )
    ),

    FDR_plot = pmax(
      FDR,
      .Machine$double.xmin
    ),

    Significant = (
      abs(logFC) >= plot_logFC_threshold &
        FDR < FDR_threshold
    ),

    Direction = case_when(
      Significant &
        logFC >= plot_logFC_threshold ~
        "Upregulated",

      Significant &
        logFC <= -plot_logFC_threshold ~
        "Downregulated",

      TRUE ~
        "Not significant"
    ),

    Function_category = classify_function(
      gene_lower = gene_lower,
      product_lower = product_lower
    ),

    Highlight_function = (
      Significant &
        !is.na(Function_category)
    ),

    Function_category = factor(
      Function_category,
      levels = c(
        "Envelope and membrane stress",
        "Stress response and regulation",
        "Membrane and periplasmic transport",
        "Energy and nucleotide homeostasis"
      )
    ),

    point_id = paste(
      NEO,
      GeneID,
      sep = "_"
    ),

    info = paste0(
      "Condition: C4.1bNEO",
      " | gene: ", gene,
      " | product: ", product,
      " | locus_tag: ", GeneID,
      " | logFC: ", round(logFC, 4),
      " | FDR: ", signif(FDR, 4),
      " | direction: ", Direction,
      " | category: ",
      if_else(
        is.na(Function_category),
        "Other",
        as.character(Function_category)
      )
    )
  )

# Preserve the previous dataframe naming convention
dge_EGFP_v_C4_1bNEO <- dge_C4_1bNEO

# ============================================================
# Separate plotting layers
# ============================================================

dge_C4_1bNEO_nonsignificant <- dge_C4_1bNEO %>%

  )

dge_C4_1bNEO_other_significant <- dge_C4_1bNEO %>%

  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  # ----------------------------------------------------------

    ),

  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  geom_hline(
```

```{r}
library(edgeR)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)
library(stringr)

# ============================================================
# Settings
# ============================================================

annotation_file <- "./data/input/Annotations.csv"

plot_logFC_threshold <- 2
FDR_threshold <- 0.05

# ============================================================
# Check required objects
# ============================================================

required_objects <- c(
  "y",
  "design"
)

missing_objects <- required_objects[
  !vapply(
    required_objects,
    exists,
    logical(1),
    inherits = TRUE
  )
]

if (length(missing_objects) > 0) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "Missing required object(s): ",
      paste(
        missing_objects,
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  )
}

if (!file.exists(annotation_file)) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "Annotation file was not found: ",
      annotation_file
    )
  )
}

# ============================================================
# Read annotation file
#
# The annotation file is expected to be a headerless,
# nine-column GFF-style CSV file.
# ============================================================

annotation_raw <- read.csv(
  annotation_file,
  header = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE,
  quote = "\"",
  comment.char = ""
)

if (ncol(annotation_raw) != 9) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "The annotation file should contain 9 columns, but ",
      ncol(annotation_raw),
      " columns were detected."
    )
  )
}

colnames(annotation_raw) <- c(
  "seqid",
  "description",
  "feature_type",
  "start",
  "end",
  "score",
  "strand",
  "phase",
  "attributes"
)

# ============================================================
# Extract one attribute from the GFF attributes column
# ============================================================

extract_attribute <- function(
    attributes,
    key
) {

  attributes <- as.character(
    attributes
  )

  pattern <- paste0(
    "(?:^|;)",
    key,
    "=([^;]+)"
  )

  value <- str_match(
    attributes,
    pattern
  )[, 2]

  value <- str_replace_all(
    value,
    regex(
      "%2C",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    ","
  )

  value <- str_replace_all(
    value,
    regex(
      "%3B",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    ";"
  )

  value <- str_replace_all(
    value,
    regex(
      "%28",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    "("
  )

  value <- str_replace_all(
    value,
    regex(
      "%29",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    ")"
  )

  value <- str_replace_all(
    value,
    regex(
      "%2B",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    "+"
  )

  value <- str_replace_all(
    value,
    "\u00A0",
    " "
  )

  str_squish(
    value
  )
}

# ============================================================
# Parse structured annotation fields
# ============================================================

annotation_parsed <- annotation_raw %>%
  mutate(
    gene = extract_attribute(
      attributes,
      "gene"
    ),

    locus_tag = extract_attribute(
      attributes,
      "locus_tag"
    ),

    product = extract_attribute(
      attributes,
      "product"
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# Return the first nonmissing annotation for each locus
# ============================================================

first_nonmissing <- function(x) {

  x <- as.character(
    x
  )

  x <- x[
    !is.na(x) &
      x != ""
  ]

  if (length(x) == 0) {
    return("N/A")
  }

  x[1]
}

# ============================================================
# Collapse annotation rows into one row per locus tag
# ============================================================

MG1655_annotation <- annotation_parsed %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(locus_tag),
    locus_tag != ""
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    locus_tag
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    chr = first_nonmissing(
      seqid
    ),

    gene = first_nonmissing(
      gene
    ),

    product = first_nonmissing(
      product
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rename(
    GeneID = locus_tag
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    GeneID = as.character(
      GeneID
    ),

    gene_lower = tolower(
      str_squish(
        gene
      )
    ),

    product_lower = tolower(
      str_squish(
        product
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    GeneID,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )

# ============================================================
# Functional classification
#
# Categories:
#   1. Envelope and membrane stress
#   2. Stress response and regulation
#   3. Membrane and periplasmic transport
#   4. Energy and nucleotide homeostasis
# ============================================================

classify_function <- function(
    gene_lower,
    product_lower
) {

  gene_lower <- ifelse(
    is.na(gene_lower),
    "",
    tolower(
      gene_lower
    )
  )

  product_lower <- ifelse(
    is.na(product_lower),
    "",
    tolower(
      product_lower
    )
  )

  case_when(

    # ========================================================
    # Envelope and membrane stress
    # ========================================================

    gene_lower %in% c(
      "pspa",
      "pspb",
      "pspc",
      "pspd",
      "pspe",
      "pspg",
      "cpxp",
      "yagu",
      "yjfj",
      "osmb",
      "bsma",
      "yiad",
      "alx",
      "asr",
      "lpxc",
      "yqae",
      "bord",
      "atpi"
    ) ~

      "Envelope and membrane stress",

    str_detect(
      product_lower,
      paste0(
        "\\bpspa family protein\\b|",
        "\\bphage shock protein a\\b|",
        "\\bphage shock protein b\\b|",
        "\\bphage shock protein c\\b|",
        "\\bphage shock protein d\\b|",
        "\\bphage shock protein e\\b|",
        "\\bphage shock protein g\\b|",
        "\\bperiplasmic protein cpxp\\b|",
        "\\bosmotically[- ]inducible lipoprotein\\b|",
        "\\bmembrane[- ]bound redox modulator\\b|",
        "\\bperiplasmic chaperone asr\\b|",
        "\\bduf1471 domain[- ]containing putative lipoprotein\\b|",
        "\\bpf13488 family lipoprotein\\b|",
        "\\budp-3-o-acyl-n-acetylglucosamine deacetylase\\b|",
        "\\batp synthase accessory factor atpi\\b"
      )
    ) ~

      "Envelope and membrane stress",

    # ========================================================
    # Stress response and regulation
    # ========================================================

    gene_lower %in% c(
      "soxs",
      "ibpa",
      "ibpb",
      "ytfk",
      "dusb",
      "fis",
      "mara",
      "marr",
      "marb",
      "rpoh",
      "iscr",
      "nahr",

      "trxc",
      "nrdh",
      "nrdi",

      "yjhq",

    ) ~

      "Stress response and regulation",

    str_detect(
      product_lower,
      paste0(
        "\\bdna-binding transcriptional dual regulator soxs\\b|",
        "\\brna polymerase sigma factor rpoh\\b|",
        "\\bstringent response modulator ytfk\\b|",
        "\\bsuperoxide dismutase \\(mn\\)\\b|",
        "\\bglutaredoxin-like protein nrdh\\b|",
        "\\breduced thioredoxin 2\\b|",
        "\\bdimanganese-tyrosyl radical cofactor maintenance flavodoxin nrdi\\b|",
        "\\btranscription elongation factor grea\\b|",
        "\\brna polymerase-binding transcription factor dksa\\b|",
        "\\buniversal stress protein\\b|",
        "\\bstress-induced protein\\b|",
        "\\bstress response protein\\b|",
        "\\bsmall regulatory rna cyar\\b|",
        "\\bsmall regulatory rna glmz\\b|",
        "\\bsmall regulatory rna rbsz\\b|",
        "\\bsmall rna rttr\\b"
      )
    ) ~

      "Stress response and regulation",

    # ========================================================
    # Membrane and periplasmic transport
    # ========================================================

    gene_lower %in% c(
      "rbsa",
      "rbsb",
      "rbsc",
      "male",
      "malf",
      "malg",
      "malk",
      "lamb",
      "yhjx",

      "mgta",

      "frua",

      "dcta",
      "nupg",
      "uraa",
      "yhbe",
      "yihn",
      "plap",
      "punc",
      "mdla"
    ) ~

      "Membrane and periplasmic transport",

    str_detect(

        "\\bfructuronate transporter\\b|",

}

# ============================================================
# Fit edgeR model
# ============================================================

fit <- glmQLFit(
  y,
  design
)

# ============================================================
# Run C7.6bNEO versus EGFP contrast
#
# Assumed design-column order:
#   1. EGFP
#   2. KpnNEO
#   3. C3.1bNEO
#   4. C4.1bNEO
#   5. C7.6bNEO
#
# Positive logFC means higher expression in C7.6bNEO
# relative to EGFP.
# ============================================================

C7_6bNEO_test <- glmQLFTest(
  fit,
  contrast = c(
    -1,
    0,
    0,
    0,
    1
  )
)

dge_C7_6bNEO <- topTags(
  C7_6bNEO_test,
  n = Inf,
  adjust.method = "BH",
  sort.by = "PValue",
  p.value = 1
)$table %>%
  rownames_to_column(
    "GeneID"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    GeneID = as.character(
      GeneID
    )
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    MG1655_annotation,
    by = "GeneID"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    NEO = "C7.6bNEO",

    gene = if_else(
      is.na(gene) |
        gene == "",
      "N/A",
      gene
    ),

    product = if_else(
      is.na(product) |
        product == "",
      "N/A",
      product
    ),

    chr = if_else(
      is.na(chr) |
        chr == "",
      "N/A",
      chr
    ),

    gene_lower = tolower(
      str_squish(
        gene
      )
    ),

    product_lower = tolower(
      str_squish(
        product
      )
    ),

    FDR_plot = pmax(
      FDR,
      .Machine$double.xmin
    ),

    Significant = (
      abs(logFC) >= plot_logFC_threshold &
        FDR < FDR_threshold
    ),

    Direction = case_when(
      Significant &
        logFC >= plot_logFC_threshold ~
        "Upregulated",

      Significant &
        logFC <= -plot_logFC_threshold ~
        "Downregulated",

      TRUE ~
        "Not significant"
    ),

    Function_category = classify_function(
      gene_lower = gene_lower,
      product_lower = product_lower
    ),

    Highlight_function = (
      Significant &
        !is.na(Function_category)
    ),

    Function_category = factor(
      Function_category,
      levels = c(
        "Envelope and membrane stress",
        "Stress response and regulation",
        "Membrane and periplasmic transport",
        "Energy and nucleotide homeostasis"
      )
    ),

    point_id = paste(
      NEO,
      GeneID,
      sep = "_"
    ),

    info = paste0(
      "Condition: C7.6bNEO",
      " | gene: ", gene,
      " | product: ", product,
      " | locus_tag: ", GeneID,
      " | logFC: ", round(logFC, 4),
      " | FDR: ", signif(FDR, 4),
      " | direction: ", Direction,
      " | category: ",
      if_else(
        is.na(Function_category),
        "Other",
        as.character(Function_category)
      )
    )
  )

# Preserve the previous dataframe naming convention
dge_EGFP_v_C7_6bNEO <- dge_C7_6bNEO

# ============================================================
# Separate plotting layers
# ============================================================

dge_C7_6bNEO_nonsignificant <- dge_C7_6bNEO %>%

dge_C7_6bNEO_other_significant <- dge_C7_6bNEO %>%
```
